engine: Godot 4.7.1 · Forward+ · Metal 4 · Apple M2 · 1920×1080 captures

pieces.name: Render & Post Stack
pieces.brief: ACES tonemap, SSAO/SSIL/SSR, volumetric fog, bloom, DOF, CA, grain, vignette, colour grade. Judged on a fixed grey-box scene for mood and grade only.

pieces.name: Camera Rig & Framing
pieces.brief: Over-the-shoulder spring-arm rig, 50-62 FOV, hero at 22-35% of frame, lock-on, impact punch and shake.

pieces.name: Environment & Level Art
pieces.brief: Nordic ruin arena: modular stone/wood kit, terrain, cliffs, snow, debris, decals, water. Four readable depth planes.

pieces.name: Lighting & Atmosphere
pieces.brief: Two time-of-day recipes (cold overcast ruin, ember hellscape), SDFGI bounce, god rays, rim separation.

pieces.name: Hero Characters
pieces.brief: Anime-styled fighters rendered with photoreal PBR+SSS. Hair cards, cloth, eyes. Judged on close-up.

pieces.name: Zombie Enemies
pieces.brief: Draugr-style undead roster with silhouette variety, rot/frost materials, emissive detail.

pieces.name: Animation & Physics
pieces.brief: Locomotion, attack sets, directional hit reactions, foot IK, ragdoll, cloth.

pieces.name: Combat Feel
pieces.brief: Hitstop, screen shake, camera punch, parry/dodge windows, commitment frames, enemy AI.

pieces.name: VFX & Impact
pieces.brief: Weapon trails, sparks, blood, impact lights, ambient embers/snow/dust. Everything additive above 1.0 HDR.

pieces.name: HUD & UI
pieces.brief: Health/rage bars, ability icons, damage numbers, lock-on reticle. Must not look like default engine UI.

pieces.name: Audio
pieces.brief: Impact layers, weapon whooshes, ambience beds, music stems, enemy vocals.
